svg.text: Tell me the songs you love, the ones you cannot stand, and the tracks already tied
to the ceremony. I’ll build the rest and mix it live.
Processional songs, microphones, and timing are confirmed
coordinator ready / photographer ready / speaker ready / signal checked
Familiar records, room to talk, and no sleepy background playlist.
I watch what people stay for, what clears space, and what brings them back.

g.text: Most songs won’t play front to back. A long playlist tells me where your taste lives.
be the one that pulls people in.
DINNER MUSIC SHOULD NOT PUT EVERYBODY TO SLEEP.
I use upbeat classics and build the volume a little at a time.
